import.title: Holiday import
import.hint: FeriadosAPI brings, once a day, the municipal and state holidays of the cities on your invoices. What you register wins over the imported one on the same date. Imported municipal holidays count in the delivery deadline and close the city's customers in the route; state ones only count in the deadline.

legend.title: How to read the Origin column
legend.national: National: comes from the system calendar and applies to every city; it is not edited here.
legend.state: State: applies to every city in the state.
legend.typed: Registered: typed by you; it wins over the imported one on the same date.
legend.imported: Imported: brought from FeriadosAPI; you can turn it off.

status.title: Import status

headline.unauthorized: Provider refused access: invalid token or plan without coverage

explain.healthy: The daily routine fetched the holidays of the tracked cities.
explain.waiting: The daily routine has not fetched anything yet. In Operations, check whether it is paused or has no token.
explain.unauthorized: The provider refused the routine's last cycle. Check the configured key and the plan contracted with the provider; in Operations, see whether the routine is paused or has no token.
explain.unreachable: The provider did not answer in the last cycle. The routine retries on its own in the next cycle; nothing needs to be done now.
explain.malformed: The provider answered in a format the routine does not understand and nothing was stored. The contract may have changed: tell support.
explain.failing: Some fetches failed. The routine retries on its own, with growing intervals.
explain.disabled: This company does not take part in the import: nothing is fetched or stored.

status.planRestricted_one: {{count}} fetch (city and year) outside the contracted plan
status.planRestricted_other: {{count}} fetches (city and year) outside the contracted plan
status.planRestrictedHint: The provider plan does not cover these cities. The others are still fetched; only a plan change fixes it.

failures.malformed_response: The provider answered in an unexpected format; nothing was stored.
failures.persistence_failed: The provider answered, but the holidays could not be stored; the routine tries again.
failures.provider_not_found: The provider did not find the city; the routine retries in 90 days.
failures.provider_plan_restricted: The provider plan does not cover this query.
failures.provider_rate_limited: The provider asked to wait; the routine tries again later.
failures.provider_unauthorized: The provider refused the access key. Check the configured key.
failures.unknown: Failure not recognized by the screen.

removed.title: Removed by the provider
removed.hint: The provider stopped listing these dates. They stay in your calendar until you decide: to keep them, edit the name or the kind in the table (the date becomes yours); to drop them, turn them off.
removed.empty: No date was removed by the provider.
removed.truncated: There are more removed dates than fit in this list. The rest show up when you handle these.
removed.confirmPrompt: Turn off “{{name}}”? It does not come back in the next runs.

suppressions.title: Turned-off holidays
suppressions.hint: Turned-off dates do not come back on their own. Restoring a date brings it back on the next daily run of the routine, not right away.
suppressions.restoredNotice: Restored. The date comes back on the next daily run of the routine.
